caption: The drawing depicts a single metal spur, shown in profile view, set against a plain, off-white background. The spur is primarily dark brown with a slightly worn appearance, suggesting the texture of aged metal. Along the curved shank and the band, there are three prominent heart-shaped inlays or decorations, each filled with a lighter, silvery-grey color that contrasts with the darker metal. The rowel, or the rotating wheel at the end of the spur, consists of a circular center with multiple evenly spaced, pointed spokes radiating outward, also in dark brown, with the central disk filled with the same silvery-grey material as the heart shapes. The attachment mechanism at the opposite end of the spur features a simple, functional design. The drawing is centrally positioned on the page, with the artist's name, “RAYMOND E. NOBLE,” written in small, uppercase letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Spur
